preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 200000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000) representing the number of tiles.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(x in {1, 2} for x in a) and (a := list(map(int, stdin.split()[1:])))
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n space-separated integers, each either 1 or 2, representing the tile values.

postconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(x in {1, 2} for x in b) and (b := list(map(int, stdout.strip().split())))
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of the input sequence, containing exactly n integers, each either 1 or 2.
The output permutation contains the same count of 1s and 2s as the input sequence.

postconditions.expression: max_primes := max(sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) if is_prime(sum(b[:i]))) for b in permutations(a)) == sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) if is_prime(sum(b[:i])))
postconditions.description: The output permutation maximizes the number of prime prefix sums, where a prefix sum is the sum of the first i elements of the permutation for i from 1 to n.
